test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Mid-Range Full Test - 04
subject: general
question: Select the number - pair that is different from the other three.
solution:
The pattern is as follows,

All the numbers at right are completely divisible by the number on the left side.

6 - 72 : 72 is divisible by 6

12 - 576 : 576 is divisible by 12

9 - 243 : 243 is divisible by 9

Only 841 is the number that is not divisible by 15

Hence, 15 - 841 is the correct answer.
